title: Story premise EDU050: The Summary Drops Its Anchor
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: What disappeared when the meeting became one sentence? Takeaway/theme: A concise summary should preserve material conditions, uncertainty, and disagreement.
description: A reporter wants to shorten a discussion, but cuts away the condition that made a proposal acceptable. A comparison restores the condition and labels remaining disagreement instead of inventing a unanimous decision.
